name: CatStudio Asset - Map Catalog -
summary:
Experience the appeal of each map in VR

CatStudio Asset - Map Catalog - is a VR viewer app that lets you freely explore the 3D map series created by CatStudio.

Step inside each map and experience what screenshots and videos can't convey: the sense of space at true-to-life scale, the way the light falls, and the atmosphere of the place itself.

Features

・15 maps included
・Move freely through each map using your controllers
・Quick access to each map's video and website
